title: Linnet ticketing software decision
brief: Linnet Telecom's support director needs a decision page on which ticketing software to buy, to be projected at the vendor review on 2026-11-10. Our load is 60 agents handling 14000 tickets a month, rising to 21000 a month from the year-end billing peak starting 2026-12-14. Open with the load as headline numbers. Then under "Options" compare four on cost per agent per month, setup cost, time to migrate and first-year cost: Helpwell, 49 dollars, 12000, 6 weeks, 47280; Ticketrail, 38 dollars, 18000, 9 weeks, 45360; Openline, self-run free software, about 3900 a month all in, 41000 setup, 16 weeks, 87800; and staying with Legacy Queue at 3100 a month, nothing to migrate, 37200 for the year but vendor support ends on 2027-06-30. Under "Fit" give a short list of what matters: automatic routing of tickets to the right team, reports by agent, and a phone integration. Helpwell and Ticketrail have all three, Openline needs custom work for the phone integration, and Legacy Queue has no routing. Under "Recommendation": Helpwell, because starting on 2026-10-28 it is live by 2026-12-09, before the peak, while Ticketrail would finish after it. Add a warning that Legacy Queue is only cheap until support ends.

edit.request: Ticketrail's vendor has cut its price to 31 dollars per agent per month, so its first-year cost is now 40320. Also add to the Fit list that Helpwell includes a chat widget for the website.
